tasks.description: Fix personality CLAUDE.md files to include JSON output format instruction. EVALUATOR FINDING: All 240 agent decisions were fallback because Claude returns markdown analysis but the AgentAPI JSON parser expects a JSON block. Each personality file needs a new required section '## Output Format' that instructs the agent to ALWAYS end their response with a JSON action block: ```json { "goal": "<goal>", "targetId": "<entity_id>", "reasoning": "<summary>" } ```. Valid goals: move_to_item, move_to_enemy, move_to_boss, move_to_safe, attack_heavy, attack_medium, attack_light, block, use_estus, pick_up_item, equip_from_backpack, pass. The JSON MUST be the last thing in the response. After writing analysis, the agent MUST output exactly the JSON block on its own line. Update all 4 personality files: personalities/aggressive/CLAUDE.md, personalities/cautious/CLAUDE.md, personalities/hoarder/CLAUDE.md, personalities/speedrunner/CLAUDE.md.
tasks.acceptance: All 4 personality files contain '## Output Format' section with JSON format instructions. Section explains valid goals, required fields (goal, reasoning), and optional targetId. Instructs agent to output JSON as last part of response. Preflight script personality check still passes (all 7 original sections + new Output Format section). Verify: grep -c '## Output Format' personalities/*/CLAUDE.md returns 4.

tasks.description: Add a game-events-based patch system that triggers after enough rounds. EVALUATOR FINDING: 0 patches applied — the balance/patch system is completely inactive. The SPEC requires at least 1 patch event during a run. Create a simple patch trigger in GameLoop.ts: after every 5 dungeon rounds, if any agent has a kill count above threshold, write a PatchSuggestion to state/patch-queue.jsonl and apply it via PatchApplier. Trigger condition: if aggressive.kills > other agents' kills combined, increase heavy_attack_cost by 20% (within ±30% of baseline). Log PATCH_APPLIED events so the evaluator can count them. This is a minimum viable patch system — just enough to satisfy the 'patch_events_during_run: true' acceptance criterion.
